insight: Free for verified U.S. clinicians and an official AI partner of NEJM and JAMA on licensed journals — used by a quarter of U.S. doctors.
name: OpenEvidence
tagline: An AI medical search engine that answers clinical questions with cited evidence.
description: OpenEvidence is a point-of-care AI search tool for clinicians, answering questions on treatment, dosing, interactions, and guidelines with evidence citations. It is free for verified U.S. healthcare professionals and draws on official content partnerships with journals including NEJM and JAMA.
